description: Block DNS lookups with unusually long encoded subdomain labels (base64 or hex shape). DNS tunneling is the standard fallback for exfiltration after HTTP is blocked — data is smuggled byte-by-byte through subdomain lookups.
message: Blocked: DNS lookup with a 40+ character encoded label detected. This is the DNS tunneling pattern used to exfiltrate data one query at a time after HTTP exfil is blocked. Legitimate DNS lookups do not use encoded subdomain labels.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks DNS lookups with encoded-looking labels on hook + runtime surfaces.
requires: Pre-tool hook installed for the calling AI tool, OR conduct runtime evaluation active for brain block tool_use
known_limitations: Cannot inspect DNS over HTTPS (DoH) or DNS over TLS (DoT) traffic
May false-positive on legitimate long service discovery labels
